stage: exposed nine-state development; frozen before native-density response predictions
reference_consistency: compute the DFT Fock and full charge/spin response at the identical native GFN2 density whose orbitals are preserved; do not transfer a kernel from the separately stationary embedded-DFT density
ground_reference: native GFN2 canonical spatial orbitals, positive restricted curvature, unchanged occupied projector
functional: standard CAM-B3LYP, omega=0.33, short/long exact exchange 0.19/0.65
F_reference: native-orbital diagonal Rayleigh quotients of the DFT Fock at the native density
Q_reference: qualified full DFT orbital energies on the same native orbitals, using unchanged matching and molecular gap safety rules
common_functional: same fixed 50/50 F/Q one-body average and the full native-density DFT charge/spin response; native GFN2 higher-order terms retained
state_interaction: unchanged stationary-ground-projected spin-pure NOSI with paired doubles
comparison: complete singlet TDA of the identical prepared functional on native GFN2 orbitals, with the full range-separated exchange correction
